sap.app.title: Semantic Page - Freestyle Sample
sap.app.description: A comprehensive sap.f.semantic.SemanticPage exercising all semantic action slots: titleMainAction, semantic title actions (add/delete/copy/edit/favorite/flag/close/fullscreen/exitFullscreen), ShareMenu (DiscussInJam/ShareInJam/Print/SendEmail/SendMessage), custom title text/icon actions, titleContent with a KPI image, titleSnappedOnMobile, and footer positive/negative/custom actions.
